description:
Cascade Flat Bar is our flat bar adventure bike. Go anywhere: Bikepacking, trails, touring, old school XC
Bikepacking and Life Hacking, or just some old school XC. Trails, tracks, loaded tours, big days out into the back of beyond. It handles all of it with the same unhurried confidence. Signature Cotic ride feel that breathes with the trail, and a rigid simplicity and beautifully clean silhouette.
The Ride
Cascade is designed to thrive offroad, not just survive. Cotic Sureshot geometry gives you agility between the trees, and long wheelbase stability and confidence when you’re loaded up or moving fast. Flat bars or Jones style bars give you options and control, and a relaxed feel to your offroad adventures.
Go minimalist with our bespoke Alpaca steel fork for the purest ride, or add 100mm suspension forks for more capability and comfort on demanding terrain. However you choose to build it, the Cascade wears every setup with confidence and panache.
Not All Steel Is Equal
Reynolds 853 is a special heat-treated steel, which makes it stronger than standard steel tubing. That lets us use thinner walls and build a lighter frame without losing the toughness steel is known for. Every Cascade is hand made in the Czech Republic. It’s a frame built to be ridden hard for years, across continents if that’s where your plans take you.
Gold Build
The Gold build has Shimano XT Di2 electronic 12-speed shifting, Hope Fortus 26 wheels and a Hope 2H headset in your choice of Hope colour, powerful Shimano XT brakes, and big-volume WTB Macro 29 x 2.4" tubeless tyres.

Features

Thinwall, air hardening Reynolds 853 steel front triangle with signature Cotic Ovalform top tube. Designed with carrying loads in mind.
44mm headset allows longer head tubes to maximise front triangle bag space, whilst on smaller sizes we can keep bar height comfortable.
Reynolds 853 34.9mm seat tube gives great precision to the ride, especially when loaded.
31.6mm seatpost size is dropper seatpost compatible, with internal "Stealth" routing.
Signature Cotic 4130 cromo wishbone stay rear end. Bridge-less S-bend chainstays with Cotic Hexten gussets for improved fatigue life.
Huge number of bosses along the down tube at 64mm bottle cage spacing for maximum luggage and cage flexibility. These also double as the cable/hose routing points.
Bosses are also at bottle cage spacing under the down tube, on the seat tube, and on top of the top tube at the head tube end, meeting the 'gas tank' bag mounting standard.
Mounting points for either full racks or mini Nitto M18 style racks on both rear of Cascade frame and on Alpaca fork. Note XS and SML frame sizes need the Cotic Rack Adapter to fit a rear rack.
Boost148 Thru Axle Rear End - Added wheel stiffness and clearance for 29x2.4 or 27.5x2.8 tyres.
483mm axle to crown Cotic Alpaca Fork, 44mm offset, Boost110 x 15 thru axle. Clearance for 29x2.6 / 27.5 x 3.0 tyres in the fork. Works great with a 100mm travel suspension fork too.
Flat Mount brakes front and rear, built up with Shimano MTB levers and 180mm rotors front and rear.
Progressive geometry designed for the dirt. Cotic Sureshot Geometry brings balance, composure, fun and speed.
Five sizes to get your fit right - XS to XL. The frames are designed to be confident and enjoyable.
Weight - Frame 2.63kg/5.8lbs for the large, with axle. Alpaca fork 1.38kg/3.04lb uncut without axle.
